## What changed

One or two sentences.

## Why

The issue, decision, or country this serves.

## Evidence

What proves that the change works. Give the result, not the method: a number next to the earlier number, the row counts (rows in, rows out, rows left out and why), or the figure before and after. Write "none" for a change of text only.

## Checks

- [ ] CI on GitHub passes for this pull request.
- [ ] `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .` and `uv run pytest` pass.
- [ ] No data, lyric text, credentials, or personal details are in the diff.
- [ ] Docs that describe the changed code are updated.
